api:
<ControlChart data={samples} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.diameter} zones={true} />
PropTypeDefault
dataas aboverequired
xFn(&T) -> f64: time, in milliseconds since the epochrequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64required
centerf64: a known process meanthe mean of the data
sigmaf64: a known standard deviationthe average moving range / 1.128
limitf64: the control limits, in σ3.
zonesbool: also draw ±1σ and ±2σfalse
colorcolour of the measurementsthe first series colour
x_axisAxisConfiga time axis
y_axisAxisConfigAxisConfig::new()
legend, tooltip, class

Points outside center ± limit × sigma are drawn in the bad colour. Estimating σ from the moving range follows the usual individuals (X-mR) chart, so a slow drift does not widen the limits.

examples.title: In control
examples.description: Centre line and ±3σ limits from the average moving range.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn in_control() {
    let data = use_signal(samples(60, 1, 0.));
    rsx! { <ControlChart data={data} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.diameter} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Process shift
examples.description: A late shift crosses the upper limit; points out of control are marked. Zones at ±1σ and ±2σ.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn shifted() {
    let data = use_signal(samples(60, 2, 0.35));
    rsx! { <ControlChart data={data} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.diameter} zones={true} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Known centre and σ
examples.description: Limits from a target diameter and a known σ.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn specified() {
    let data = use_signal(samples(60, 3, 0.2));
    rsx! { <ControlChart data={data} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.diameter} center={25.} sigma={0.1} limit={3.} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Zones, no legend
examples.description: A stable process with ±1σ and ±2σ zones and the legend hidden.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn zoned() {
    let data = use_signal(samples(60, 4, 0.));
    rsx! { <ControlChart data={data} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.diameter} zones={true} legend={Legend::hidden()} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Downward shift
examples.description: The diameter drops late in the run, with zones and the legend on the right.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn falling() {
    let data = use_signal(samples(60, 8, -0.4));
    rsx! { <ControlChart data={data} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.diameter} zones={true} legend={Legend::list().right()} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: Tight known σ
examples.description: A known σ of 0.05 is tighter than the process, so natural noise breaks the limits.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn tight_spec() {
    let data = use_signal(samples(60, 9, 0.));
    rsx! { <ControlChart data={data} x={|s: &Sample| s.time} value={|s: &Sample| s.diameter} center={25.} sigma={0.05} zones={true} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: 4σ limits
